page.title: Izihlanganisi
page.intro: Qhagamshela iiakhawunti zakho zentengiso. Iinkokeli ezisuka kwiintengiso zakho zifika kwiiNkokheli zam ngokuzenzekelayo, ngenkcitho kunye neendleko zokukhokela.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form ikhokelela kwiiNkokeli zam, inkcitho yemihla ngemihla kunye neendleko ngokukhokela, kunye nomgangatho okhokelayo obuyiselwe kwi LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn iqhagamshelwe. Iinkokeli ziyalandwa ngoku - eli phepha lihlaziywa ngephanyazo.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn ayikamiswa kulo mncedisi okwangoku. Umlawuli kufuneka wongeze ID yomxhasi we LinkedIn app kunye nemfihlo.
banner.expired: Uqhagamshelo lwe LinkedIn luphelelwe lixesha, ngoko ke izikhokelo azivumelanisi. Qhagamshela kwakhona ukuze uqhubeke.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn ifuna ukuba ungene kwakhona ngo- {{date}} . Qhagamshela kwakhona ngaphambi koko ukuze ugcine umkhondo uhamba.

connect.title: Connect LinkedIn
connect.intro: Sayina ungene nge-akhawunti LinkedIn elawula iintengiso zakho. Leadrat ifunda kuphela ii-akhawunti zakho zentengiso, Lead Gen Form ikhokela kunye neenkcukacha zentengiso, kwaye ithumela iinguqu ozivulayo.
connect.need1: Indima kwi-akhawunti yentengiso LinkedIn (Umbukeli okanye ngaphezulu).
connect.need2: Indima kwiphepha lenkampani edibeneyo (uMlawuli, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , uMgcini okanye uMhlalutyi) - LinkedIn ifuna ukuba yabelane ngezikhokelo.
connect.need3: Umbuzo wenombolo yefowuni Lead Gen Forms - ikhokelela ngaphandle kwenombolo yefowuni ayinakongezwa.

connection.title: Uqhagamshelwano
connection.autoRenews: Ufikelelo luhlaziywa ngokuzenzekelayo kude kube ngoko
connection.syncResult: Ungqamaniso lwenziwe: {{received}} yamkelwe, {{created}} yaliwe, {{duplicates}} phinda, {{rejected}} yaliwe.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Susa uqhagamshelwano LinkedIn ? Ukuyeka ungqamaniso kunye neethokheni zofikelelo ziyacinywa. Isikhokelo, izibalo kunye nelog yomsebenzi zigcinwa.
connection.noPermission: Ungajonga eli phepha. Ukuqhagamshela kunye nokutshintsha izicwangciso kufuna imvume "Lawula iiSetingi".
connection.fetchHint: Izikhokelo ezintsha zijongwa rhoqo kwimizuzu embalwa kwaye iintsuku ezi-7 zokugqibela ziphinda zihlolwe yonke imihla, ngoko akukho nto iphosakeleyo. Sebenzisa oku kukhokelo olusuka phambi kokuba uqhagamshele, okanye ujonge ixesha kwakhona (ukuya kuthi ga kwiintsuku ezingama-90 ngexesha). Imikhombandlela esele Leadrat iyatsitywa.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Xelela LinkedIn ukuba yeyiphi yeenkokeli zayo eziye zaba lithemba lokwenyani. Xa ukhokelo lwe LinkedIn lufikelela kwisimo osikhethayo ngezantsi, Leadrat ibika kwi LinkedIn , ngoko ke iingxelo zakho zephulo zibonisa umgangatho okhokelayo kunye ne LinkedIn unokufumana abantu abaninzi abafana nabahamba phambili. Kuphela i ID ye LinkedIn ehamba phambili kunye ne-hash yendlela enye ye-imeyile ithunyelwa.
capi.created: Uguqulo lwenziwe kwi LinkedIn kunye nemephu.

activity.title: Umsebenzi welog
activity.intro: Yonke into phakathi Leadrat kunye LinkedIn : uxhulumaniso, yonke i-sync, yonke isikhokelo kunye nento eyenzekayo kuyo, ukuguqulwa kunye neempazamo.
